record: HH16 E2201 one-shot local-profile-edit boundary probe
scope: One volatile synthetic fixture run against the existing fixture provider, service runtime, public controller, and renderPublicSite emitted tree. Exercise seeded-owner login, pre-save copy, delegated draft updates, save, public-alias reentry, and fresh provider/runtime/controller initialization over the same session storage. No product/source/Git edits.
expectedObservation: The profile page discloses before save that changes are not sent to the public service. Saving emits localOnly=true and a local-only outcome; it changes only the controller's in-memory overlay, with zero provider-port calls, runtime Part/receipt changes, runtime snapshot changes, or fixture storage changes during save. The overlay remains visible through same-controller public-alias navigation, but a newly constructed controller/provider/runtime over the same fixture session storage shows the original seeded profile. This would falsify a concern that Save silently persists or publishes profile edits; it would not establish browser behavior or a retention defect.
falsifier: The bounded local-only claim is falsified if the actual emitted pre-save tree lacks the local/no-public-service disclosure, the save result does not identify a local-only result, save calls a provider write/update port, runtime/provider state or storage changes during save, or the saved value survives a fresh controller/provider/runtime through fixture state rather than the current controller overlay. Any such mismatch stops interpretation and is reported without repair or retry.

sourceInspection.appDelegation: app.mjs delegated input calls controller.updateDraft(target.name,target.value); submit calls reportValidity then FormData and dispatches the named event. Probe mirrors only the non-secret draft delegation and direct controller dispatch; it does not execute DOM APIs.
sourceInspection.controller: public-controller.mjs owns profileOverlays in a closure; public:profile-edit validates ownership, updates that map and emitted state, returns localOnly, and does not call service(); public alias reads merge the current controller overlay. A newly constructed controller has a fresh overlay map.
sourceInspection.renderer: public-site.mjs renders the edit form and page-level copy: 'This is a locally rendered profile. Changes and sharing are not sent to the public service.'
sourceInspection.provider: The fixture provider advertises profileEdit:false and declares create/get-own/open-public profile ports, with no profile-update port. No TeacherProfile.updateProfile is invented or invoked.
sourceInspection.existingCoverage: Existing tests cover basic edit/save, render replacement draft values, alias access, and runtime unchanged; this probe targets the untested fresh controller/provider/runtime boundary and captures the pre-save rendered disclosure plus provider/runtime/storage deltas.

fixturesAndControls.fixtureIdentity: seeded avery@fixture.test; no real account or email
fixturesAndControls.credential: random one-use string generated in memory only for fixture login and scanned for absence from output, state, runtime Parts, provider data, and storage; never printed or persisted
fixturesAndControls.editedValues: synthetic profile name/bio, not personal data
fixturesAndControls.failurePolicy: First task/probe failure stops execution; retain originals, no automatic retry, overwrite, assertion weakening, source edit, or rerun.

outputPolicy: Preserve prospective.json, probe.mjs, run-once.sh, and original stdout.raw/stderr.raw/exit.code/start.utc/end.utc through the exclusive capture paths. Do not interpret this emitted-tree/controller probe as browser DOM, native validation/FormData, backend persistence, production-service, or human evidence.
